All repairs and warranty replacements are subject to parts availability. For further details contact us at https://mythospedals.com/pages/contact The Erlking is back! An early member of the Mythos lineup, this nod to that classic green Nashville overdrive has been long requested to make a return by customers. The Erlking takes the phenomenal ODR-1 topology and expands the range of controls by adding a Bass control. This lets you dial in this circuit to work with any pickup configuration. The controls on this pedal are very interactive and there is a ton of flexibility in this circuit. If you need a mild boost, mid gain drive or pretty cranked dirt sound it's all here, with a useful tone circuit that tastefully adjust the highs. Plug a T-style guitar into this pedal and then into a Black panel amp and you have that iconic Nashville overdrive sound. Grab a LP and push a British head and it's classic rock and roll. This really is a versatile drive that we're happy to bring back into the fold. The Erlking is the first Mythos Pedal to be made in the new folded 125b size enclosure.
